answer: In an agent economy, every identity voting on shared spending must lock a $100 bond for 30 days, with one vote per bond and no borrowing against locked funds inside the protocol. Whether agents fund a haven, buy a lantern, or authenticate a relic, creating extra names adds no free votes: an attacker seeking 10,000 votes must immobilize $1 million, bearing financing costs and losing access to that capital for the month.
